description: This file defines the 'Calculate' class which implements a mini-language operation for performing calculations, including parsing XML elements to define calculation steps, and executing arithmetic operations with various data types and formatting options.

classes.name: Calculate
classes.description: Main class implementing the <calculate> element, supporting arithmetic operations, data type conversions, and formatting within the mini-language framework.

classes.name: Calculate.SubCalc
classes.description: Interface for sub-elements of <calculate> that can compute a BigDecimal value.

classes.name: Calculate.CalcOp
classes.description: Implements the <calcop> sub-element, supporting addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and negation.

classes.name: Calculate.NumberOp
classes.description: Implements the <number> sub-element, converting string values to BigDecimal.

classes.name: Calculate.InvalidOp
classes.description: Represents an invalid sub-element, throws exception if used.

classes.name: Calculate.CalculateFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of Calculate.

methods.name: Calculate
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Calculate object by parsing XML element attributes and child elements.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the calculation, performing arithmetic operations, formatting, and storing the result in the specified field.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the <set> element with its attributes.

methods.name: calcValue
methods.description: Method in SubCalc interface to compute a BigDecimal value based on the current method context.
